dedupe_keys.name: cim libcimpp c library for reading cim and cgmes power system models

description: CIM++ is a software project from the Institute for Automation of Complex Power Systems (ACS) at RWTH Aachen University around libcimpp, a library that turns XML/RDF documents following the Common Information Model standards (IEC 61970, 61968 and 62325) into C++ objects. The FEIN Aachen project page explains that a toolchain maps a CIM data model specified in UML to compilable C++ code, from which the deserialiser is generated, so that CIM-to-X translators can follow new CIM versions. The README, now under the SOGNO platform on GitHub, calls libcimpp a serialiser and deserialiser and lists supported CGMES versions 2.4.13 (2013), 2.4.15 (2016 and 2020) and 3.0.0. Coverage: power system network models exchanged in CIM or CGMES. Format and access: C++ source on GitHub, built with CMake and one of the libxml2, Xerces or Microsoft XML parsers; API documentation for CGMES 3.0.0 on GitHub Pages. Licence: Mozilla Public License 2.0 (G-PST Open Tools Portal); a LICENSE file is present in the repository. Caveats: release history and activity dates were not read. Simulation uses: loading grid models from transmission operators' CIM/CGMES exports into power flow and dynamic simulators. Related records: DPsim (model-dpsim), also from RWTH Aachen's SOGNO work, is a power system simulator that can take CIM models.
